Job Description:

The Communications Liaison will provide writing, editing, and communications support for the Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network (OPTN) patient safety and compliance program. This role is responsible for technical editing of all contract deliverables, reviewing and refining materials for OPTN committee and Board meetings, coordinating public-facing communications, and serving as the primary liaison between the project team and HRSA/OPTN communications staff.

The Communications Specialist ensures that written products are clear, accurate, consistent with federal plain language and branding requirements, and compliant with HRSA/OPTN review processes. This role combines strong editorial skills, stakeholder coordination, and knowledge of federal communication standards to support transparent, high-quality communication about OPTN patient safety, membership, and compliance activities.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Editing and Quality Control of Deliverables

  • Perform detailed technical editing, copyediting, and proofreading of all written deliverables under the contract (e.g., plans, SOPs, reports, meeting summaries, training materials).

  • Ensure consistency in style, tone, terminology, and formatting across documents and presentations.

  • Apply federal Plain Language Guidelines and HRSA/OPTN style and branding requirements to all materials.

  • Review documents for clarity, logical flow, and alignment with program objectives and regulatory context; work with technical leads to resolve ambiguities and strengthen key messages.

  • Support the development and maintenance of editorial standards, templates, and checklists for project deliverables.

2. Committee and Board Materials Support

  • Review and refine slide decks, briefing documents, talking points, and other materials prepared for Safety and Compliance Committee(s), OPTN Board, and related workgroups.

  • Ensure meeting materials clearly describe goals, decisions needed, and key background information, and are appropriate for the intended audience (e.g., clinical, technical, leadership, public).

  • Check all materials for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to confidentiality, redaction, and sensitive information requirements.

  • Coordinate timelines for materials review and finalization to meet established deadlines for committee and Board meetings.

3. Public-Facing Communications

  • Draft, edit, and format public-facing content describing Safety and Compliance Committee(s) activities, membership, accomplishments, and key policy or program updates (e.g., website content, fact sheets, summaries).

  • Ensure all public materials:

    • Follow OPTN branding and HRSA communications guidance.

    • Use plain language and are accessible to non-technical audiences.

    • Comply with federal requirements (e.g., no lobbying, no commercial advertising, no non-federal logos outside OPTN).

  • Support preparation of de-identified, public-facing meeting summaries and other materials for posting to the OPTN website.

  • Assist in developing standard templates and messaging for recurring public communications.

4. Liaison to HRSA/OPTN Communications

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact between the project team and HRSA/OPTN communications staff.

  • Coordinate routing of draft public materials for review and written approval from the COR and HRSA/OPTN communications team, per contract requirements.

  • Track communications requests from HRSA and ensure timely, complete responses in coordination with internal subject matter experts.

  • Maintain documentation of approvals, branding guidance, and communications SOPs, and ensure the project team applies them consistently.

5. Internal Coordination and Support

  • Work closely with project managers, committee operations staff, analysts, and subject matter experts to understand content, context, and intended audiences for deliverables.

  • Support preparation of visually clear, accessible materials (e.g., charts, tables, graphics) in alignment with Section 508 accessibility requirements.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of communication products and processes, including recommending updates to templates, workflows, and review processes.

  • Help ensure that all communications-related tasks and timelines are integrated into project plans and tracking tools.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, English, Public Health, Public Policy, Health Administration, Journalism, or a related field.

  • Master’s degree in a related field is preferred but not required.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in technical editing, communications, or similar roles supporting complex programs or projects.

  • Experience working with or supporting federal agencies, healthcare, public health, or regulatory/compliance environments is strongly preferred.

  • Prior experience supporting leadership, committee, or board-level communications is a plus.

Skills and Competencies

  • Technical Editing & Writing: Demonstrated ability to edit complex, technical content for clarity, consistency, and readability while preserving accuracy.

  • Plain Language & Policy Translation: Skilled at translating technical and regulatory concepts into clear, accessible language for diverse audiences.

  • Attention to Detail: Exceptional accuracy in grammar, formatting, and content review; strong ability to identify inconsistencies and gaps.

  • Compliance & Branding Awareness: Familiarity with, or ability to quickly learn, federal plain language requirements, branding guidelines, and restrictions on lobbying and advertising.

  • Stakeholder Coordination: Experience working with multiple stakeholders (e.g., program staff, clinicians, policy experts, communications offices) to refine and finalize materials.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide constructive editorial feedback and to clarify complex content with subject matter experts.

  • Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel), SharePoint/Teams, and virtual meeting platforms; experience preparing accessible documents (Section 508) is preferred.

  • Organization & Time Management: Ability to manage multiple concurrent deadlines, prioritize work in a fast-paced environment, and meet quality and timeliness expectations.

Part-Time, Roanoke, VA - Bilingual Spanish

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirement.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Demonstrated experience handling anti-bot mechanisms and dynamic site structures at scale
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and containerization (Docker) as part of real workflows
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, OpenRouter, or similar) applied to automation tasks
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

On this project, contributors can earn up to $40 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Aperçu de l’entreprise

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.


Department Overview

Motorola Solutions' innovations, products, and services play essential roles in people's lives. Our end-to-end suite of software solutions helps customers manage emergency communications, process video and evidence, and leverage cutting-edge AI-driven analytics for security and operational insights. We are industry leaders in video security and analytics, with solutions deployed in more than 120 countries across diverse environments such as school campuses, transportation systems, healthcare centers, public venues, critical infrastructure, prisons, factories, casinos, airports, financial institutions, government facilities, and retailers. Our AI-powered security solutions integrate advanced video analytics, machine learning, and embedded intelligence to enable proactive threat detection, enhanced situational awareness, and automated decision-making.


Job Description

Job DescriptionThe Director of Computer Vision will drive the technical vision, research and engineering execution for the platform, with focus on the following core areas:

  • Foundational Research Strategy: Define the long-term research agenda for fundamental computer vision capabilities and drive the culture of scientific excellence.

  • Technical Vision, Engineering Leadership, and Execution: Provide executive technical leadership to a unified research and engineering organization, defining the technical architecture, strategy, and engineering roadmap for the Computer Vision Platform. Drive execution, ensuring the seamless translation of product requirements into robust technical specifications and successful delivery of next-generation visual intelligence solutions that are highly scalable and align with overall product and business strategy.

  • Organizational Leadership and Talent Strategy: Manage and scale a unified computer vision research and engineering organization distributed across multiple geographies, overseeing multiple teams, and defining the strategy for recruiting, mentoring, and attracting world-class talent.

  • End-to-End MLOps and Deployment: Own the entire engineering lifecycle for central, reusable computer vision models and foundational AI infrastructure. This includes establishing best-in-class MLOps practices for scalable training, efficient deployment, continuous monitoring, and performance optimization across edge and cloud environments.

  • Performance Measurement and Continuous Improvement: Define, implement, and track key technical performance metrics (e.g., latency, throughput, model efficiency, system reliability) to measure engineering success, identify bottlenecks, and drive continuous improvement in execution and delivery.

  • Technical Innovation and Risk Management: Evaluate and integrate cutting-edge computer vision research and technologies. Proactively identify and mitigate significant technical risks, and lead critical engineering decisions, including build-versus-buy analysis.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of technical leadership experience leading computer vision teams and organizations, with a focus on building and deploying enterprise-scale platforms and solutions in production.

  • Technical Acumen & Deep Expertise: Deep, demonstrable expertise in computer vision, machine learning algorithms, and the end-to-end MLOps lifecycle, including 5+ years of hands-on experience building and optimizing computer vision models or as a computer vision researcher. Proven ability to engage in complex technical discussions, define the architectural vision for central, reusable AI infrastructure and models, and drive technical strategy while managing critical trade-offs.

  • Executive Technical Strategy & Metrics: Proven experience defining long-term technical vision, engineering strategy, and roadmaps for a large-scale platform.   • Experience producing technical documentation and operational runbooks that enable reliable support and knowledge transfer.

  • Professional maturity and ability to operate calmly in business-critical situations, taking accountability through to resolution.

Overview

As part of the Americas Commercial Marketing team, the Principal Market Development Manager - Pharmaceuticals will play an integral role in the development and execution of a dynamic integrated marketing plan that helps achieve business objectives of our instrumentation, software, consumables, and services business within the Americas Pharmaceutical markets. Through a good understanding of customer requirements, market dynamics, regulatory influences, the individual will collaboratively develop and execute marketing and sales strategies aimed at generating pipeline revenue which fuels our growth in the Pharma market.

Responsibilities

  • Tactical Plan Design and Execution: Develop and successfully implement a marketing business plan that is aligned with the corporate strategy to help deliver the Pharmaceutical revenue goal within the Americas. Create an integrated marketing plan that helps promote awareness of Waters solutions (e.g., marketing communications, digital campaigns, seminars, user meetings, customer visits, scientific meetings and tradeshows) to both new-to-Waters and recurring customers.
  • Demand Generation: Responsible for the strategy and execution of marketing activities to generate and nurture leads across multiple market segments via events, digital marketing, targeted social media advertising, and cooperative marketing with partners to optimize pipeline fill and acceleration.
  • Monitoring and reporting: Oversee marketing performance and impact to the business via tracking across relevant KPIs, including but not limited to marketing qualified leads (MQLs), conversion rate, funnel creation, campaign/tactic success measures, orders/sales.
  • Support of Sales Specialists: Maintain regular dialogue and assist with the activities of Field Sales and Service teams for business development promotion and execution, as well as support within specific sales situations as necessary. Support the strengthening of a KOL network to support our efforts in the country.
  • Advocate for Internal and External Customer Needs: Being an advocate for region’s internal and external customers such that training, product, services, and business requirements are met. Work across multiple product, service, vertical market, and geographic organizations to build consensus and influence to affect change and ensure needs of country are understood and accounted for.
  • Local Industry SME/Champion: Become established subject matter expert regarding Pharmaceutical industry within the Americas, working with teams across Sales, Product, Service, Global to influence and support efforts impacting Pharmaceutical customers and our ability to educate and engage them regarding our solutions.
  • Market Trend Analysis: Spotting trends in applicable markets, by competitors, customers and sharing with appropriate regional and corporate groups. Identify potential business opportunities for Waters. Fully understand, maintain and report on competitive activities and positioning

Qualifications

  • Minimum Bachelor’s degree in scientific, engineering, or marketing discipline
  • 7+ years of experience in marketing and business development, preferably with demonstrable experience with Waters or similar instrumentation/software/services supporting the Pharmaceutical industry
  • Proven ability to develop and execute business plans. Able to lead from the front with little direct support.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills: communicate effectively, drive execution, foster innovation, focus on the customer, collaborate with others, solve problems creatively
  • Maintain professional internal and external relationships that meet Waters core values
  • Proactively establish and maintain effective working team relationships with all corporate departments both local and global
  • Self-motivated with the ability to flexibly respond to changing demands

Company Description

Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of ~16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.

jobs.description:
Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our Mission is to “Transform mental health by making it more accessible, affordable and effective”.

Position Type: Full-Time |Remote |Hourly, Non-Exempt

Compensation: $20 / hour

Schedule: Full-time shifts within center hours of operation, Monday–Sunday (Central/Eastern coverage); some evenings and weekends

Who We Are

Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our mission is to empower our patients to live healthier, more rewarding lives through accessible, affordable, and effective mental healthcare tailored to their needs. Our Patient Support Center is the front door to that care, often a patient’s first human connection with Geode and the first step in removing barriers between someone seeking help and the provider who can support them.

The Role

The Patient Support Specialist is a high-impact, phone-first role at the heart of patient access and acquisition. You are an ambassador for patients and care teams and the first voice many prospective patients hear and a key partner in helping them move from interest or referral to a scheduled first visit. You’ll turn high-intent inbound calls, referral callbacks, and web leads into appointments while delivering a warm, hospitality-driven experience. A smaller share of your day is spent helping established patients by resolving simple requests or routing them to the right team.

This is a fast-paced, quality-focused environment for people who care deeply about both outcomes and experience. You’ll use strong virtual human connection, sound judgment, and customer-centric problem solving to remove barriers to care, connect each patient to the right provider, and help activate a trusted relationship with their care team. If you bring empathy, urgency, and a growth mindset, and believe every call is an opportunity to help someone take the next step, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Convert High-Intent Inbound Calls

  • Answer new patient inbound calls, including referral callbacks and consumerleads with warmth, urgency, and a bias toward booking the first visit.
  • Match each patient to the right provider using screening questions, insurance, provider preferences, and scheduling tools to secure the best-fit appointment.
  • Guide ambivalent or hesitant callers toward a confident “yes” using empathy, reflective listening, communication frameworksand sound judgment while removing barriers without pressure.
  • Set clear expectations for the first visit so patients arrive informed, comfortable, and ready to attend.
  • Collaborate with internal teams when needed to resolve open questions and create a seamless handoff for patients and providers.

Support Established Patients

  • Handle a smaller volume of established-patient contacts, resolving simple requests or routing to the right team quickly and accurately.
  • Capture complete, accurate patient context and insurance information; follow up to close any gaps.

Grow Through Coaching & Quality

  • Work toward individual and team goals for conversion, answer rate/service level, quality, and after-call work, using feedback and performance insights to keep improving.
  • Welcome regular call auditing and coaching as fuel for growth; apply feedback quickly and consistently.
  • Document every interaction accurately in our systems with the right context and a clear next step for each patient.

Own Patient Experience

  • Create a calm, personalized experience that helps patients feel confident taking the next step in care.
  • Protect patient privacy by maintaining strict confidentiality and following HIPAA and all privacy requirements.
  • Flex with changing workflows, volumes, and schedules while supporting the broader team as needs shift.

Who You Are

  • A hospitality-minded people person - you make others feel genuinely cared for and you love creating great experiences.
  • Motivated by goals and comfortable using feedback and performance insights to improve.
  • A persuasive, empathetic communicator who can navigate emotional or complex conversations with calm and confidence.
  • You stay organized and calm while handling multiple systems, changing priorities, and a high volume of calls.
  • Coachable and self-aware - you welcome feedback, know your strengths, and actively develop your areas of opportunity.
  • Passionate about mental healthcare and Geode’s mission to expand access to exceptional care.

What You Bring

  • 1–3+ years in a customer-facing, phone-based, or hospitality role; healthcare, call center, or sales/conversion experience is a strong plus.
  • Comfort working in a goal-oriented, quality-focused environment.
  • Familiarity with insurance plans and benefits, or the ability to learn them quickly (preferred).
  • Strong computer skills and the ability to navigate multiple systems while maintaining a warm, focused conversation with the patient.
  • A quiet, professional remote workspace and reliable connectivity.
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred.

At Geode Health, we offer:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Flexible schedule

  • In-person and virtual patient visits

  • Comprehensive admin support (front office, accounting, finance, payroll, HR, etc)

  • Professional development opportunities

  • Clinical community, support, and leadership

  • Medical, dental and vision benefits

  • Life insurance

  • Short and long-term disability

  • Paid vacation and holidays

  • Matching 401k plan

  • State of the art technology

Why work for Geode Health?

At Geode Health, we take our commitment to patients and providers seriously. We focus every day on how to help patients across the United States get the best possible mental health care available. To achieve this, we focus on ensuring our providers have unmatched support and resources so that they can focus on providing great care. We are backed by KKR, a leading private equity firm with the experience and mission alignment to truly make an impact. Joining Geode Health will put you on the front-end of a rapidly growing movement to increase access and improve outcomes for mental health patients and providers across the nation.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

‎

Commercial Organization | GTM Enablement

Reports to: Director, GTM Enablement

The Lead, Channel Enablement owns the enablement strategy and infrastructure that helps Castlight-powered solutions get sold effectively through our channel ecosystem, including health plans, strategic partners, resellers, and Marketplace relationships.

This role is the Commercial owner of the second sale enablement motion and the connective tissue across Castlight, our partners, and the teams responsible for bringing our solutions to market. The Lead builds the training, demos, tools, and repeatable programs that allow partner sellers and Castlight teams to confidently position, demonstrate, and sell Castlight-powered solutions at scale.

The role also owns the core demo infrastructure supporting channel selling, ensuring our Figma environments, screen libraries, and partner-specific experiences stay current as the product evolves.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

What You'll Own

Channel & Partner Enablement

  • Build and own the channel enablement strategy across health plans, strategic partners, resellers, and Marketplace partners.

  • Develop scalable enablement programs that help partner sellers understand the buyer problem, articulate the Castlight value proposition, demonstrate the solution, and advance opportunities.

  • Create partner-ready training programs, playbooks, talk tracks, FAQs, objection handling, templates, and selling tools using Product Marketing's approved positioning and messaging.

  • Partner with Strategic Partnerships to build tailored enablement programs based on partner type, commercial model, seller audience, and go-to-market motion.

  • Support the launch and ongoing readiness of new partner relationships and Castlight-powered offerings.

Second Sale Enablement

  • Own the enablement framework for the second sale motion across health plan and partner channels.

  • Establish one source of truth for second sale training, demos, tools, templates, and selling standards.

  • Prepare Castlight Commercial and Client teams for the transition of second sale execution to Client CSMs by September 30.

  • Build repeatable training and certification approaches that allow Client teams to execute consistently while maintaining Commercial standards.

  • Create scalable processes for Commercial review, feedback, and continuous improvement as execution moves closer to the client and health plan teams.

Demo Strategy & Engineering

  • Own the core demo environments supporting health plan, partner, reseller, and second sale motions.

  • Build and maintain Figma-based demos, screen libraries, reusable components, and partner-specific demo experiences.

  • Maintain demo environments as products, capabilities, positioning, and user experiences evolve.

  • Lead Nova conversions across the existing channel book and establish the standards for new partner implementations.

  • Manage partner access to demo environments and establish clear governance around version control, usage, and updates.

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $40/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

About the team

At Zillow Group, our mission is to empower people to unlock life's next chapter. The Platform Engineering team owns the infrastructure every engineer at Zillow builds on, spanning compute and runtime, networking and connectivity, databases, secrets and identity, and the delivery tooling that moves code to production. We are shifting from an infrastructure operations model to platform-as-a-product, replacing ticket queues and manual provisioning with golden paths, self-service, and API-first interfaces so that product teams can focus on business outcomes instead of operational complexity.

Increasingly, this platform serves AI agents alongside the engineers directing them. Our self-service paths are evolving to support agent-driven, pipeline-driven, and hybrid workflows, making Platform Engineering foundational to how quickly and safely Zillow can build with AI.

About the role

As a Principal Product Manager for Platform Engineering, you will own product strategy for the platform capabilities that every engineering team at Zillow depends on. You will define the golden paths teams follow by default, drive adoption and migration onto those paths across thousands of services, and establish the measurement and value model that makes the platform's impact visible to the business.

This is the first dedicated product role in the organization. Platform Engineering has already built many of the foundations of a product operating model — customer discovery, written product requirements, and outcome metrics are how these teams work today — with engineering leaders carrying that work alongside running their teams. As a Principal Product Manager, you will raise the ceiling on that practice, partnering with engineering leadership across six teams to deepen discovery, sharpen prioritization, and organize the roadmap around customer problems and value streams rather than infrastructure layers.

Your scope spans the full platform surface — though the areas you drive most directly will be shaped by where the leverage is greatest as near-term product needs across the teams stabilize. At this level, you will define the operating model other teams plan and build within, not just execute within it yourself.

  • Own platform strategy across Platform Engineering's portfolio, turning independently run infrastructure roadmaps into a coherent product direction with explicit investment tradeoffs

  • Define the golden paths for how engineers build at Zillow, designing the platform so the supported path is the fastest one and unsupported patterns are difficult to fall into

  • Drive adoption and migration outcomes across teams with no reporting relationship to you, using defaults, deprecation paths, and enablement mechanisms that produce measurable change in how teams build

  • Define how applications and AI agents consume platform capabilities, establishing which self-service paths are agent-driven, which remain deterministic, and where human approval is required

  • Establish how platform success is measured — adoption, onboarding time, satisfaction, and key customer outcomes — and build the underlying value model of what capabilities cost to serve and what they are worth

  • Experience owning a platform portfolio rather than a single product area — multiple interdependent capabilities with different customers, maturity levels, and lifecycles — and prioritizing across them

  • Proven track record driving adoption of platform standards across teams you do not manage, using defaults, deprecation paths, and mechanisms that drove measurable change in behavior

Responsible and accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns, and personally following policies and procedures as defined. Accountable for always doing the right thing for customers and colleagues, and ensures that actions and behaviors drive a positive customer experience. While operating within the Bank's risk appetite, achieves results by consistently identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring, and reporting risks of all types.

  • Hands on experience with Venafi/Cyberark
  • Working knowledge of AWS and cloud security
  • Familiarity with Digicert, Sectigo, and various certificate types

Bold in how we dream and innovate

Data Modeling & Business Logic

  • Translate business requirements into reusable data models
  • Ensure consistency of core metrics across reporting
  • Align Databricks outputs with Power BI semantic models

  • Build testable, production-ready pipelines
  • Support impact analysis using lineage tools
  • Participate in CI/CD and deployment processes

Performance Optimization & Operations

  • Troubleshoot issues across environments
  • Ensure data consistency between dev, test, and prod
  • Support high-volume data workloads

AI & Automation (Preferred)

  • Contribute to AI-driven engineering practices

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with BI and business teams
  • Support governance and cataloging efforts
  • Document data models and pipelines

  • 8+ years data engineering experience
  • Strong Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake experience

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community Associate Vice President, Strategy Advancement and Decision Quality The Associate Vice President, Strategy Advancement and Decision Quality provides cross-functional strategic leadership to improve the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of enterprise and market-level decisions across Finance, IPA, Markets, and Growth Strategy.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Associate Vice President, Strategy Advancement and Decision Quality

The Associate Vice President, Strategy Advancement and Decision Quality provides cross-functional strategic leadership to improve the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of enterprise and market-level decisions across Finance, IPA, Markets, and Growth Strategy. This role serves as an independent challenge and alignment function, ensuring strategic priorities, business assumptions, and key decisions are grounded in market realities, competitive dynamics, provider strategy, and enterprise objectives.

The Associate Vice President partners with senior leaders to strengthen decision-making rigor, improve organizational alignment, and elevate business outcomes through sound judgment, effective governance, and disciplined evaluation of strategic tradeoffs. As a leader in strategy advancement, this role works across functions to improve how decisions are made, information is evaluated, and strategic priorities are translated into action through stronger decision frameworks, governance processes, and organizational alignment.

The Associate Vice President serves as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, bringing an enterprise perspective to complex issues that span markets, products, provider relationships, and functional areas. The role helps surface emerging risks, identify critical interdependencies, and support leaders in navigating complex decisions. Success requires a deep understanding of organizational capabilities, market dynamics, and enterprise strategy, coupled with the ability to synthesize complex information into actionable insights and influence stakeholders without direct authority.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy Advancement and Decision Quality

  • Serve as an independent challenge and alignment function to improve the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of enterprise and market-level decision making.
  • Evaluate strategic priorities, assumptions, and growth initiatives to ensure alignment with enterprise objectives and market realities.
  • Advance organizational decision-making capabilities through improved frameworks, governance mechanisms, and decision disciplines.
  • Serve as Secretary of all Bid Decision Forums, maintaining the official record of decisions, assumptions, deliberations, votes, and action items while ensuring adherence to governance standards and established decision-making protocols.
  • Support Bid Decision Forum Chairs in the execution of governance responsibilities, including agenda development, decision documentation, issue escalation, and communication of outcomes.
  • Promote a culture of rigorous analysis, constructive challenge, accountability, and disciplined decision making across business functions.

Strategic Advisory and Enterprise Alignment

  • Act as a trusted advisor to executive leaders on significant strategic, operational, and market-related decisions.
  • Facilitate alignment across Finance, Markets, Provider Strategy, and Growth Strategy on priorities, assumptions, and key decisions.
  • Identify strategic interdependencies, unintended consequences, and areas of organizational misalignment.
  • Support enterprise governance and decision forums by ensuring discussions are informed by objective analysis and strategic context.
  • Drive greater transparency, consistency, and accountability in strategic decision-making processes.

Leadership and Organizational Influence

  • Lead, coach, and develop team members while fostering a culture of strategic thinking, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Influence senior leaders and stakeholders without direct authority to drive alignment and improve decision quality.
  • Build strong partnerships across business functions to advance organizational effectiveness and business outcomes.
  • Represent the function in enterprise governance, bid, and strategic leadership forums.


Use your skills to make an impact

Decision-Making Scope

This role is expected to:

  • Shape enterprise and market-level decisions through independent challenge, strategic analysis, governance leadership, and cross-functional influence.
  • Recommend changes to assumptions, priorities, strategies, and decision approaches when warranted by analysis or changing market conditions.
  • Establish and enhance decision-making frameworks, governance mechanisms, and strategic review processes.
  • Serve as Secretary of enterprise Bid Decision Forums, helping ensure decision integrity, accountability, and institutional continuity.
  • Escalate significant risks, strategic tradeoffs, and organizational misalignments to executive leadership as appropriate.
  • Serve as an objective voice that strengthens organizational decision quality without assuming ownership of functional operations, financial planning, forecasting, or reporting.

Key Partnerships

The Associate Vice President will partner closely with:

  • Finance leadership
  • Individual Medicare Advantage leadership
  • Market Presidents and Market Leadership Teams
  • Growth Strategy leadership
  • Provider Strategy and Network leaders
  • Product and Pricing leaders
  • Enterprise Strategy and Governance leaders
  • Bid Governance Forums and executive decision-making bodies
  • Executive Leadership Team members supporting enterprise strategy and growth

40

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

   

Who We Are

 

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Inclusion & Diversity 

 

We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re looking for an Associate Enablement Manager to support our Sales Development Representative (SDR) organization—the engine that drives our pipeline and fuels our growth. The SDR team is a fast-paced, high-volume environment where rapid skill acquisition, process discipline, and consistent execution are critical to success.

In this role, your superpower is execution and flawless organization. You will be responsible for managing multiple onboarding cohorts simultaneously, ensuring every new SDR is equipped with the tools, playbooks, and confidence they need to hit the ground running. Beyond onboarding, you will manage multiple enablement projects at once—from outbound sequencing updates to tech stack rollouts. As a strategic partner to SDR Leadership, Marketing, and Operations, you will translate process and strategy into highly structured, actionable training that accelerates ramp time and drives pipeline. This is a high-impact role with a clear growth path, including the opportunity to take ownership of major workstreams and scale into an Enablement Manager role.

What you’ll do

  • Manage Multi-Cohort Onboarding: Own the end-to-end execution of our SDR onboarding program, managing multiple overlapping cohorts at different stages of their ramp period without dropping the ball.

  • Drive Execution & Process: Build the foundational cold-calling, emailing, objection-handling, and qualification skills of SDRs so they can consistently book high-quality meetings.

  • Coordinate Concurrent Projects: Efficiently balance multiple enablement initiatives at once, ensuring project timelines for playbooks, campaigns, and tools are met seamlessly.

  • Create Structured Resources: Maintain, update, and deliver playbooks, talk tracks, sequence templates, and workflow guides that reinforce outbound and inbound best practices.

  • Optimize the Tech Stack: Train the team on maximizing efficiency within our SDR tech stack (e.g., Salesforce, Nooks, ZoomInfo) and track usage compliance.

  • Measure & Iterate: Leverage data, scorecards, and LMS metrics to track onboarding ramp times and identify areas for ongoing upskilling and programmatic improvement.

  • Facilitate High-Energy Training: Deliver engaging, structured group sessions, call blitzes, and roleplay workshops that build pipeline-generation momentum.

What you’ll need

  • Experience: BA/BS degree and 1–2 years of experience in sales enablement, as a high-performing SDR/BDR, or in a project management role within a B2B SaaS go-to-market function.

  • The "Execution" Superpower: Hyper-organized, detail-oriented, and project-disciplined. You have a proven track record of managing multiple complex projects or cohorts simultaneously with zero oversight.

  • SDR Savvy: Familiarity with modern inbound/outbound sales methodologies, sequencing strategy, cold calling, and pipeline generation.

  • Tech Stack Fluency: Quick learner with the ability to navigate and train others on tools like CRM (Salesforce), Sales Engagement Platforms and Conversational Intelligence

  • Communication & Facilitation: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; comfortable commanding a room, coaching competitive personalities, and running high-energy workshops.

  • Thrives in Speed: Comfortable in a high-volume, fast-paced environment where priorities shift quickly and execution speed is a competitive advantage.

  • Action-Oriented: A proactive problem-solver with a strong bias toward action, execution, and driving absolute clarity out of ambiguity.

  • Adult Learning Foundations: An understanding of how to optimize training for adult learners, ensuring onboarding is interactive, practical, and execution-focused rather than purely theoretical.

Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.


Use of AI Technology:

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.


What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.
  • Holistic health and wellness benefits: Company-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical.
  • Support for Titans at all stages of life: Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more.

jobs.description:
Description

TripleTen is a career learning platform for people in a world being reshaped by AI. We help people learn the tech and AI skills to move into higher-paying roles and keep up as the economy shifts. Established in 2019, we are part of Nebius Group, a global leader in AI infrastructure. We work remotely across the US, Europe, LatAm, and beyond.

About the role

﻿

Our brand and marketing team ships a lot with few people across several zones, and the small work has outgrown us: pages to update, articles to republish, tickets going stale, finished work nobody can find. This role picks that up and puts a system under it. The biggest recurring piece is the blog. Search engines were happy to leave a good article alone for a year; AI assistants are not, so everything we publish gets refreshed regularly.

You’ll report to our Brand Director and work closely with a strong team of brand, organic and social media marketers, designers, and copywriter.

What you will do

  • Blog refresh: Work closely with our SEO/GEO Growth Engineer to update roughly 10-20 published articles a month with Claude. Update facts, tighten structure, put finished text live and check if its formatting, links, images, and copy landed well.
  • Small page edits: Minor changes on live pages—a date, a price, a link. Our Claude agents know where the components live, but they need you to tell what to change.
  • Coordination: Chase the pieces an article needs before it ships: a student quote, a cover brief, a fresh instructor photo; ping a vendor for a lost invoice, get it and upload into our internal billing system.
  • The records: Keep the change log and team’s Jira board current.
  • The system: help us identify repeatable tasks and their cadence to initiate automations and then keep them running.

Requirements

  • Hands-on work with Claude or similar: You've used one on real work, and you know where it gets things wrong.
  • Junior project-management skill: You carry a batch of small tasks at once and close them without being chased. You'd rather build a system than keep remembering.
  • A careful eye: You catch a wrong number, a dead link, a changed heading.
  • B2+ English: Strong enough to spot AI patterns in published copy and hear when a sentence stops sounding natural.
  • Comfortable in a repo and a tracker: we use GitHub + Claude Code, WordPress, Jira, Figma, Notion. If you’re not familiar with them, be prepared to pick up quickly.

Nice to have:

  • Basic marketing understanding: enough context to see why a page, an article, or a funnel exists, how they get found, and question links with no UTMs.
  • Experience keeping a team's tickets, files, or documentation in order.

What we can offer you

  • Remote, part-time collaboration (about 20 hours per week).
  • Room to grow into more hours, full-time and a wider role in brand, marketing, or production.
  • Full onboarding into our AI-first stack and our brand kit.
  • A close-knit global team across the US, Europe, and LatAm.

jobs.title: Sr. Designer
jobs.excerpt: Our Company Empowering everyone to create.  Adobe empowers everyone, everywhere to imagine, create and bring digital experiences to life.
jobs.description:
Our Company

Empowering everyone to create.

Adobe empowers everyone, everywhere to imagine, create and bring digital experiences to life. From creators and students to small businesses, global enterprises and nonprofit organizations, customers choose Adobe products to create, collaborate, grow, and build remarkable experiences.

We are looking for curious, ambitious makers who want to help define world-class creativity in this new era. We believe the craft is more essential than ever while AI should help people create more, explore more, and unlock new possibilities while keeping creators at the center of the creative process.

Adobe is amplifying human ingenuity with AI.

Our Team

Adobe Creative is Adobe’s in-house brand-creative engine, developing the ideas, campaigns, and assets that power Adobe’s brand and business. We are part of the broader Content & Creative (“C&C”) organization. We work alongside Adobe Content, which focuses on publishing and audience development through owned, earned, and partner channels; an Experiences team, which oversees Adobe’s real-world moments; and shared service teams spanning Video, Talent, Partnerships, and Production.

Together, C&C commissions and produces work while equipping teams across Adobe’s Global Marketing Organization and the company to create, adapt, and distribute high-quality work with greater speed and consistency.

The Opportunity

Adobe makes the tools the world uses to create. Our own design work should set the standard for what those tools make possible. Adobe Creative is looking for an exceptionalSenior Multidisciplinary Designerto create beautifully crafted, culturally relevant work across Adobe Creative’s output.

You will work across campaigns, multi-platform design, product storytelling, motion and live experiences, moving confidently between early visual exploration, design development and polished final execution.

Working alongside Design leaders, Creative Directors, Art Directors, Copywriters, Strategists and Product partners, you will help turn ideas into distinctive visual expressions that feel recognizably Adobe without becoming repetitive or formulaic.

You will combine exceptional design craft with curiosity for emerging technology. You will use Creative Cloud, Firefly and AI-enabled workflows to explore more widely, prototype more quickly and make stronger work without compromising taste, originality or human judgment.

You are a maker first. You care deeply about typography, image-making, composition, and the details that make an idea feel fully resolved.

What You’ll Do

Design Across the Work

  • Create high-quality design across campaigns, multi-platform design, product storytelling, and live experiences.

  • Develop work from early concept and visual exploration through design development and final execution.

  • Apply exceptional craft across typography, image-making, layout, composition and art direction.

  • Work across high-velocity everyday output and highly crafted flagship work.

  • Adapt strong ideas across channels and formats without losing their intelligence or visual impact.

  • Create work that feels connected and recognizably Adobe while remaining fresh, distinctive and culturally relevant.

Turn IdeasintoVisual Worlds

  • Partner with Creative Directors, Design Directors and Art Directors to develop visual territories and creative systems.

  • Translate campaign and creative ideas into compelling art direction and design expression.

  • Collaborate with Copywriters to develop visual and verbal ideas as one connected creative system.

  • Create mood boards, prototypes, and design studies that help teams explore and align early.

  • Know when to explore broadly and when to refine toward a clear, production-ready solution.

  • Bring a strong visual point of view while remaining open to collaboration and critique.

Build Scalable Creative Systems

  • Create modular frameworks, templates and reusable design tools that support speed without losing craft.

  • Help translate Adobe’s brand system into distinctive creative expression across real work.

  • Test how design ideas perform across channels, formats and audience needs.

  • Find opportunities to improve tools and workflows based on real creative applications.

  • Balance systematic thinking with experimentation, surprise and flexibility.

  • Document design thinking clearly so others can apply it effectively.

Advance AI-Native Design

  • Use Creative Cloud, Firefly and emerging generative tools throughout concepting, prototyping and production.

  • Use AI-enabled workflows to expand visual exploration and accelerate iteration without lowering the standard.

  • Apply human judgment, taste and craft to all AI-assisted work.

  • Help define where AI can support scale and where human authorship and intervention remain essential.

  • Test emerging Adobe capabilities through real creative work and share useful feedback with Product teams.

  • Apply responsible AI practices, including provenance, creator rights and Content Credentials.

Collaborate and Deliver

  • Work closely with Creative Directors, Art Directors, Copywriters, Motion Designers, Strategists, Producers, Product and Product Marketing.

  • Present work clearly, explain design decisions, and respond constructively to feedback.

  • Partner with Production to carry ideas into execution while protecting their creative intent.

  • Collaborate with photographers, illustrators, artists, studios, and specialist partners whenrequired.

  • Maintain a high design standard through fast timelines, multiple workstreams, and changing priorities.

  • Take ownership of your work while contributing generously to the ideas and development of the wider team.

What You Need to Succeed

  • You consider yourself a maker first. AI fluency is how you work, not a skill you are developing.

  • 6+ years of experience in design, art direction, or multidisciplinary creative practice.

  • A standout portfolio demonstrating exceptional design craft across multi-platform campaigns and product storytelling.

  • Deep expertise in typography, layout, image-making, and visual composition.

  • Strong fluency across digital, motion, and emerging design practices.

  • Strong conceptual thinking and the ability to carry an idea from exploration through final execution.

  • Experience working across both high-velocity creative and highly crafted flagship work.

  • Experience applying brand systems in ways that feel distinctive and alive.

  • Strong systems thinking and experience creating modular frameworks, templates or reusable creative tools.

  • Fluency with Adobe Creative Cloud, Firefly and AI-enabled visual workflows.

  • A clear perspective on how generative AI changes visual exploration, authorship and production.

  • Experience working within multidisciplinary teams and collaborating with Copy, Motion, Strategy and Production.

  • Strong presentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • A genuine and current understanding of culture, design, art, technology and emerging visual practices.

  • The ability to balance speed, experimentation, and craft.

  • A maker approach, curiosity and a commitment to continuously improving the work.


About Adobe

Assist in financial analysis, pricing, and risk assessment to estimate outcomes. Support business decision-making through actuarial analysis, healthcare cost trend evaluation, and the identification of savings opportunities across healthcare data sources.

jobs.description:
If you are a passionate Full Stack Developer with expertise in Elixir, Phoenix and LiveView, and you're excited about revolutionizing the investment industry by crafting solutions for operational challenges and turning best practices into scalable, valuable products, Allocator One could be the perfect destination for your skills.

Come join our team where you'll play a crucial role in automating fund management and regulatory tasks, offering a transformative approach to the future of venture capital funds. You'll be working on all aspects of the application, from coding up user interfaces and components to building new endpoints or integrations. Our team has a good sense of humor and enjoys having fun. If you want to be part of this journey, keep reading!

We're on the lookout for individuals who've mastered either Elixir or React.js at a senior level, with at least a junior-level grasp of the other technology. If you're a senior pro in Ruby or Python and have a thirst for diving into Elixir, we're all ears and highly encourage you to apply.

As a member of our core team, you will work very closely with our founders, key stakeholders, and other experts. You will have the opportunity to learn from and contribute to the team's collective knowledge and expertise, and to participate in all aspects of the Allocator One value chain. The role will report into a Founding Partner.

Note: Allocator One is headquartered in Vienna, Austria. We offer the flexibility for this job to be performed remotely.

Allocator One

At Allocator One, we operate a distinctive fund model designed to invest in the most promising first-time fund managers worldwide while optimizing fees. With an eye on the highly favorable prospects for the 2023/2024 fund vintages, our team has accelerated its efforts to seize this unique opportunity. We pride ourselves on being the anchor investor of choice for exceptional first-time fund managers, offering them unparalleled access, expertise, and operational support.

Our focus on first-time fund managers

Allocator One's focus on first-time fund managers is driven by a simple yet compelling fact: historically, top-performing funds with assets under $50 million, led by emerging managers, have delivered returns that are more than 3 times higher over a 10-year horizon compared to their peers of larger fund sizes. Furthermore, the fund vintages of 2023/2024 in our pipeline are poised to enjoy an additional boost in returns. Venture capital funds that originate during economic recessions have consistently achieved returns that are 15%-30% higher compared to those raised in the preceding years, across various performance percentiles.

Optimizing fees and building Partnerships

We believe in optimizing fees while nurturing partnerships with first-time fund managers from the very beginning. Our aim is to enhance investment terms by actively contributing to the success of these funds. Allocator One has already established itself as a global brand in the realm of emerging managers, thanks to our extensive international investor network. In just two months since our launch, we've received over 300 applications, a testament to our commitment to supporting emerging talent. Our team goes beyond traditional investing; we offer to act as "co-builders," incorporating emerging managers into our unique Allocator One program, often likened to a "Y Combinator for Capital Allocators." We provide vital support in areas such as regulation, administration, and structure.

Our founding partners:

Our founders bring a wealth of experience and expertise to Allocator One:

  • Felix Staeritz: As the builder of category-leading corporate venture builder FoundersLane, Felix has an impressive track record of founding and exiting successful ventures. He is an active VC/PE investor and serves on the boards and advisory boards of esteemed organizations like the World Economic Forum (WEF), Fraunhofer, and various public and private companies.
  • Michael Ströck: Michael is a seasoned open source developer and entrepreneur with multiple successful exits to his name. He is an alumnus of Y Combinator and has transitioned from a CTO role to a successful investor. Michael has played a pivotal role in establishing three VC funds and is part of a family business now in its third generation.

Tasks

General responsibilities:

  • Implement new features on our web application
  • Solve complex programming challenges using functional programming languages (Elixir, in our case)
  • Develop new user-facing features using Elixir, Phoenix and LiveView
  • Build reusable components and front-end libraries for future use as specified by the UX team
  • Translate designs and wireframes into high-quality code integrated with the backend
  • Optimize components for maximum performance across a vast array of web-capable devices and browsers
  • Collaborate with the development team to develop a strategy that enables a great user experience
  • Continuously research new and best coding practices
  • Perform regular code reviews/PR reviews for your colleagues

jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior eClinical Business Lead (IRT and DHT Design Consultant). As a Senior eClinical Business Lead, you will support clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in RTSM and DHT study design, requirements analysis, stakeholder collaboration, and clinical trial optimization. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to study operations from planning through closeout. Responsibilities include providing expert consultation on digital health technology implementation, translating complex requirements into actionable solutions, and ensuring seamless integration across clinical trial systems.

You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through advancing clinical trial technology, improving study efficiency, and enhancing patient engagement. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior eClinical Business Lead can explore career paths and expand expertise across clinical research and digital health innovation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide expert consultation to project leaders and study teams on RTSM and DHT study design, requirements gathering, and system configuration

  • Analyze protocols and collaborate with stakeholders to develop, review, and validate user requirements that align with study design objectives and regulatory standards

  • Identify, assess, and mitigate risks related to RTSM and DHT implementation, ensuring compliance with clinical trial processes and data integrity standards

  • Translate complex technical and business requirements into clear, actionable guidance for study teams and system users to facilitate informed decision-making

  • Evaluate system integrations and proactively identify potential issues with third-party interfaces, data flows, and user requirements to ensure seamless functionality

  • Partner with UAT leads to design, execute, and validate testing protocols, ensuring systems meet defined requirements and business objectives

  • Stay current on emerging RTSM and DHT technologies, industry best practices, and regulatory developments to drive continuous improvement and innovation

  • Manage quality assurance and timely delivery of project deliverables while implementing corrective actions to maintain excellence

  • Interact with external clients to discuss RTSM and DHT design considerations, protocol requirements, and implementation strategies

  • Demonstrate proactive problem-solving and deliver timely, effective solutions to client challenges and technical issues

Candidate Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Deep expertise in RTSM and DHT systems, clinical trial design, and requirements management

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with the capacity to work independently and escalate appropriately

  • Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment

  • Exceptional ability to collaborate across teams and communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse audiences

  • Patient-focused mindset with strong attention to detail and commitment to data integrity

  • Comfort working with RTSM platforms, digital health technology (DHT) solutions, and clinical trial management systems (CTMS)

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

  • 5+ years of experience in building RTSM and/or DHT clinical trial systems, developing user requirements, and managing requirements gathering, configuration, design, and user acceptance testing

  • Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes

  • Excellent technical and data standards knowledge with proven experience applying data standards in clinical trial environments

  • Demonstrated ability to create and explain business processes and train others on implementation

  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of industry standards such as CDISC SDTM and other data standards relevant to clinical trials

  • Experience with eCOA or ePRO systems and digital health technology platforms

  • Proven track record of conducting root cause analysis and driving process improvement initiatives

  • Demonstrated client-focused approach with ability to build and maintain strong client relationships

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!
